hero.title: Distributed Market Intelligence
hero.subtitle: Self-Validating Quant Platform
hero.tagline: A self-validating quant pipeline with live job tracking, a Next.js control plane, and a static Vercel demo for recruiter walkthroughs.
hero.impact: Most projects stop at results — this one validates them in real time, streams every stage over WebSocket, ships signals and backtests, and exports a fixture-backed demo that runs without FastAPI or PySpark.

problem.label: 01 — The Problem
problem.title: Four gaps most financial projects ignore.
problem.intro: Most projects stop at "I got results." These four gaps matter in production.

howItWorks.label: 02 — How It Works
howItWorks.title: Four layers, seven pipeline stages — plus a static demo.
howItWorks.pipelineNote: Then SAVING_DATA → COMPLETED; UI fetches via /features, /qa, and /api/v1/*. Live stack: API :8080 + web :3002. Demo stack: demo/ :3003 on fixtures only.

status.label: 04 — Status
status.title: Build status — all planned phases complete.

problems.d: Pandas breaks at scale — PySpark handles multi-ticker workloads.
Rolling metrics and drawdown need careful window functions per ticker.
Formal QA scores Spark output against a Pandas/SciPy benchmark.
WebSocket streams every pipeline stage — no black-box runs.

archLayers.title: UI Layer
archLayers.desc: Next.js live dashboard (web/) + static portfolio demo (demo/) sharing components

archLayers.title: Processing Layer
archLayers.desc: PySpark — ingest, validate, features, QA, signals, backtest, versioned export

archLayers.title: Job & Persistence
archLayers.desc: BackgroundTasks + job_id + DuckDB history; single active-run lock (409)

flowStepsDetail: Next.js UI — ticker input (dates in config/config.json)
Seven stages above, then SAVING_DATA → COMPLETED
DuckDB stores jobs, QA, signals, backtests per run_id
Single pipeline lock — 409 if a run is already active
Snapshot mode: per-ticker CSV under data/snap/; live mode: yfinance
Demo refresh: seed pipeline → capture GETs → fixtures under demo/public/fixtures/
Vercel Root Directory = demo — zero backend, fixture replay of pipeline steps

highlights.name: QA Validation System
highlights.desc: Spark outputs benchmarked against Pandas/SciPy — per-ticker alignment % in qa_report.json (>95% target).

highlights.name: Signals & Backtest
highlights.desc: Rule-based BUY/SELL/HOLD with confidence + reasons; signal_rules_v1 metrics (CAGR, Sharpe, max DD, win rate).

highlights.name: Real-time Execution
highlights.desc: WebSocket timeline for all stages; job_id routing; 409 lock on concurrent runs.

highlights.name: Next.js Control Plane
highlights.desc: Live web/ dashboard — Jobs, Explorer, QA, Signals, Regime, Backtest, Reports, Settings.

highlights.name: Static Demo / Vercel
highlights.desc: demo/ app with fixture snapshot, historical step replay, and refresh scripts — no API required to deploy.

highlights.name: Local Research Platform
highlights.desc: backend/ + web/ + demo/ + config/; Docker Compose; start_live_dev.sh / start_demo_dev.sh.

techStackPrimary.role: Live web/ dashboard + demo/ portfolio UI

techStackSecondary.role: Live or offline per-ticker data under data/snap/

techStackSecondary.tech: Rule engine + RSI / vol / SMA filters
techStackSecondary.role: BUY / SELL / HOLD with confidence & reasons
CAGR, Sharpe, max drawdown, win rate, profit factor

futureWork: Phases 1–5 are complete: PySpark pipeline, FastAPI, Next.js live UI, WebSocket job tracking, and the static Vercel demo with fixture capture. Optional research waves (richer indicators, HMM regimes, HTML/PDF reports, formal pytest goldens) remain outside the shipped core.
